### Love the Place You Want to Leave
Author: Scott Hubbard
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/love-the-place-you-want-to-leave
Passage: Jeremiah 29:4-7
Points:
- God sovereignly places His people right where they are, even in difficult or unwanted circumstances.
- Rather than living with packed bags and waiting to leave, believers are urged to settle down and invest in life there.
- God calls exiles to seek the good and peace of their surrounding city instead of turning inward.
- Sharing the gospel and serving neighbors turns an unwelcome environment into a harvest field.
- Remembering our true heavenly home empowers us to faithfully love and serve our present earthly community.

### Overcoming Discouragement
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-february-27-2021.html
Passage: Jeremiah 29:11
Points:
- Believers frequently face heavy trials and confusion where God's purposes seem hard to understand.
- Even the prophet Jeremiah knew deep sorrow before penning God's promises of restoration.
- God's declared plan for His people is designed for their ultimate welfare rather than destruction.
- Hardships like illness, loss, and setbacks do not mean God has abandoned His throne.
- We can overcome discouragement by resting in God's trustworthy character and eternal purpose.

### Are Your Trusting God’s Plan
Author: Kirstyn Mayden
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/beloved-women/beloved-women-january-26-2021.html
Passage: Jeremiah 29:11
Points:
- Human schedules and carefully organized plans are inevitably disrupted by life's changes.
- God's reassurance to the Babylonian exiles reminds us that His overarching intentions are redemptive and good.
- Unplanned detours invite us to respond with gratitude rather than complaints.
- Trusting God during uncomfortable seasons allows Him to mature our faith and direct our steps.

### So What’s the Plan?
Author: Katie Harmon
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement-cafe/encouragement-caf-may-24-2018.html
Passage: Jeremiah 29:11
Points:
- People often look to this promise wanting a detailed, step-by-step map for their future.
- God usually reveals only the immediate next step to cultivate our daily reliance on Him.
- Instead of worrying about unknown future details, we should follow the clear commands God gave in Scripture.
- The Lord is far more concerned with sanctifying our souls than satisfying our curiosity.
- True peace comes by walking humbly, acting justly, and trusting God’s ongoing provision.
